preconditions.expression: all(c in {'a', 'b', 'c'} for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string must be either 'a', 'b', or 'c'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join('b' if c == 'a' else 'a' if c == 'b' else c for c in s)
postconditions.description: The output string is obtained by switching the positions of 'a' and 'b' in the input string, while leaving 'c' unchanged.
